none_html: No backup has reported here yet. Run deploy/backup.sh on the host (from cron, daily): each run leaves its result in the data directory, and this panel reads it.

offsite.none: none: OCTOPUS_BACKUP_REMOTE is not set, so the archives live on this machine only

restore.lede: To restore it, run this on the host that took it. The daemon's data and database are replaced.
restore.needs_database_url: Export OCTOPUS_DATABASE_URL in the shell first: the status file leaves it out because it holds the password.
